conviction_note: Q3 is close to an empty quarter: REVTORPYK only became commercially available on 2026-09-30, so the print will turn on what management says about October demand, EAP-to-commercial conversion and J-code friction. Findings sum to +2.0 because a crowded short and a -55% drawdown sit under a print with a very low bar. The scaled number is smaller (p_up 52 x abs 11 = +0.44) because the skew already prices upside (-16.7 vol points, calls bid) and the launch-quality signals point both ways.
bar: Disputed and tiny. Q3 2026 revenue: Yahoo Finance average $0.52M from 10 analysts (high $4.17M, low blank), https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/CELC/analysis/ (read 2026-11-05); FXEmpire $1.59M from 9 analysts, https://www.fxempire.com/stocks/celc/earnings. Q3 EPS -1.46 (FXEmpire) to -1.53 (Yahoo, 2 analysts). Q4 2026 revenue (Yahoo) averages $20.09M from 11 analysts, range $6.5M-$53.7M. No company guidance (Q2 release https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001603454/000119312526349227/celc-ex99_1.htm). The two revenue sources disagree, so every finding that depends on the Q3 revenue bar is capped small. print_vs_bar_pct +20 is a low-conviction guess that late-September distributor stocking clears a ~$1M bar.
positioning_check: Short interest 10.25M shares at the 2026-10-15 settlement, 5.8 days to cover (https://massive.com/quote/celc, read 2026-11-05). That is about 21% of 48.93M shares outstanding. The 2026-09-30 figure was 10.98M shares and 11.0 days. Sweep row: 32.3% of float at 2026-08-14 (Yahoo) and 21.0% (equibles); providers disagree on float. Skew is -16.74 vol points (25d put IV minus 25d call IV), so calls are bid and the market is paying for upside. Put/call OI is 0.78; the ATM spread is 41% of mid, so the implied move is indicative. Price: -55.5% from the 52w high, -6.9% over 5 days, about -7.5% intraday on print day (massive.com, 13:04 EST). Baker Bros sold 3.1M shares at $102.50 on 2026-07-14 and left Section 16, so the largest holder no longer reports. 63% institutional. The crowded short shrinks any negative finding.

findings.finding: REVTORPYK was announced commercially available in the US only on 2026-09-30 at 08:00 ET, after the 2026-07-14 approval. Q3 product revenue can therefore be at most initial buy-and-bill distributor stocking on the last day or two of the quarter. The bar is $0.52M (Yahoo, 10 analysts) to $1.59M (FXEmpire, 9 analysts). Any stocking order of a few hundred $10,000 vials would beat it, but would carry almost no demand information.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior revenue print: every one of the 7 prior reactions (median abs 3.1%) was pre-revenue. On 2026-08-13 an EPS miss (-1.44 vs -1.16) bought +6.2%.
findings.why_not_priced: The consensus split ($0.52M vs $1.59M, high $4.17M) shows the street has not agreed whether stocking lands in Q3. If it had, the estimates would cluster. A stocking-driven beat is likely to be discounted, so the size is small.
findings.independence: Q2 release guided 'shipments ... late third quarter 2026', consistent with this (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001603454/000119312526349227/celc-ex99_1.htm).

findings.finding: Management said on 2026-09-08 (Wells Fargo conference) that the US Expanded Access Program was active, had a 'positive response', and that its patients would transition to commercial drug. Per the 2026-09-09 Citi summit, EAP drug was free until commercial availability and not in sales. An installed patient base should therefore convert to paid commercial use in October, which management can cite on the call as early Q4 demand.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None: there have been no launch-metric prints. The stock fell about 19% on 2026-07-15 when the launch was delayed after approval, which shows how sharply it reacts to launch-timing and launch-quality news.
findings.why_not_priced: No EAP enrolment count has been published, and the Q4 revenue estimates span $6.5M-$53.7M (Yahoo), so the street does not know the size of the converted base. If the base were priced, Q4 estimates would be tighter and the stock would not be at its lows into the print.
findings.independence: Q2 8-K exhibit: 'Expanded Access Program opened ... shipments to participating physicians have started' (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001603454/000119312526349227/celc-ex99_1.htm). The Citi summit summary (https://quartr.com/events/celcuity-inc-celc-citigroup-s-biopharma-back-to-school-summit-2026_oqufg2jk) is a separate event. Both quartr pages are AI summaries.

findings.finding: REVTORPYK is an infused, buy-and-bill drug launching on a temporary J-code. Management acknowledged 'initial reimbursement friction' that extended payment terms are meant to offset. Expect a slow first-quarter demand ramp in community oncology, and channel inventory that extended terms may have inflated.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior launch print. The 2026-07-15 launch-delay news cost about 19%.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the stock is -55% from its high. The specific J-code and extended-terms mechanics have only appeared in conference summaries, not in wire previews. Sized small because about 21% of shares are short and calls are bid.
findings.independence: Same document as finding 2, so the two are not independent; they are opposite readings of one launch setup and both stand. Citi summit, separate: payer access in the mutant population depends on NCCN updates (https://quartr.com/events/celcuity-inc-celc-citigroup-s-biopharma-back-to-school-summit-2026_oqufg2jk).

findings.finding: Management has already set the commercial bar low: no revenue guidance, time to peak sales 36-42 months (longer than established pharma), revenue named as the primary launch metric (Citi 2026-09-09, Wells Fargo 2026-09-08). Cautious Q4 commentary therefore lands on lowered expectations, but the Q4 estimate range is wide ($6.5M-$53.7M), so the bar is unclear.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None on guidance; the company has never guided revenue.
findings.why_not_priced: The top Q4 estimate is $53.7M against an average of $20M. Some of the street models a fast ramp that management's 36-42-month framing does not support, so a first guide or qualitative steer could reset the high estimates either way.

findings.finding: The sNDA for the PIK3CA-mutant cohort was submitted 2026-08-26, so the FDA's day-60 filing decision fell around 2026-10-25. No acceptance or PDUFA date has been announced, and the Q3 release is the natural place to disclose it. Management expects approval in Q2 2027 (standard review). A priority-review designation would be an upside surprise.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Acceptance of the original NDA with priority review (2026-01-20) was not separately measured. The approval day (2026-07-14/15) fell about 19% on launch timing.
findings.why_not_priced: Acceptance is expected and inside what the company said (Q2 2027 approval), so it is small. Only a priority review, a PDUFA earlier than Q2 2027, would be new.
findings.independence: Wells Fargo summary: sNDA submitted, approval expected Q2 2027 (https://quartr.com/events/celcuity-inc-celc-wells-fargo-21st-annual-healthcare-conference_oqufg2zz).

findings.finding: Crowded short into a first-launch print: 10.25M shares short (about 21% of shares outstanding), 5.8 days to cover at 2026-10-15. The stock is -55.5% from its 52w high, -6.9% over 5 days and about -7.5% intraday on print day. Any reassuring October demand comment has a squeeze mechanism behind it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Post-print drift after 2026-08-13 was reported at +15.3% (earningswhispers via search), with a +6.24% first reaction despite an EPS miss.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the skew is -16.7 (calls bid), so the option market already pays for upside. If the squeeze were fully priced, the skew would be even more call-heavy and the stock would not be selling off into the print. Shrunk for that.
findings.independence: Sweep row: 32.3% of float short at 2026-08-14 (Yahoo); equibles 21.0% / 6.8 days at 2026-08-20. Other providers, earlier dates.

findings.finding: Cash, equivalents and short-term investments were $754.0M at 2026-06-30, with runway 'at least into 2029'. The term loan was repaid from the $575M 0.25% 2032 convert. No near-term equity raise is needed, so the Q3 opex step-up (consensus EPS about -1.5 x 48.9M shares, roughly $73M net loss) funds the 88-90-rep launch rather than signalling distress.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Financing-overhang days (ATM, convert announcements) were negative in 2026 per rallies.ai/stockopedia headlines. The Q2 print, which showed the cash surge, rose +6.2%.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced. Filed because a print with Q3 cash above roughly $680M closes off the dilution question that has driven several 2026 sell-offs.

findings.finding: At ESMO 2026 (LBA, 2026-10-24) the updated VIKTORIA-1 PIK3CA-mutant cohort showed the PFS benefit over alpelisib holding in visceral and liver-metastasis subgroups and no clinically meaningful effect on glucose. Stomatitis remains early-onset. This supports the sNDA and the label-expansion story the call will repeat.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The ASCO 2026 mutant-cohort data (mPFS 11.1 vs 5.6 months) sent the stock down about 22-26%, on expectations that were too high.
findings.why_not_priced: Public for 12 days, so mostly priced. Filed only because the call will restate it.

findings.finding: Baker Bros funds sold 3.1M shares at $102.50 on 2026-07-14, the approval day, and the reporting person is no longer subject to Section 16. Any further selling by the former largest holder is now invisible, which is a residual supply overhang into the print.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The stock fell from about $102 to about $64 after the sale; the sale itself is not separately measurable.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced after almost four months. A small residual, because holders who file 13G only quarterly can keep selling unseen.
findings.independence: massive.com insider tracker: Julian Baker $291M at $102.50 avg (https://massive.com/quote/celc).
